a.lede: On Equity, we debate the impact of data center moratoriums and whether the AI industry has a communication problem.
a.title: Can the AI industry persuade data center opponents by getting rid of NDAs?

b.lede: Amazon says it will stop using NDAs when negotiating data center deals with local governments, following a similar move from Microsoft earlier this year.
